description.value: A family-run campground 25 minutes north of Prince George on the Salmon River, with riverfront and forested tent sites, a renovated washhouse with flush toilets and free hot showers, and an on-site coffee-and-treats shack; advance reservations required and a two-night minimum applies on weekends and July–August.

address.value: 3865 Salmon Valley Road, Prince George, BC V2K 5X3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and provides strong evidence for most fields. Phone (250-971-2223) and address (3865 Salmon Valley Road, Prince George, BC V2K 5X3) are confirmed on multiple subpages. The Q&A page explicitly states no laundry on site, WiFi only at the Coffee & Treat Shack (not campground-wide), and confirms hot showers in the wash house. The on-site Coffee & Treat Shack confirms food availability. OSM's internet_access=wlan tag is misleading — WiFi is limited to the Treat Shack per the website.
concerns: OSM has no phone number in tags; phone 250-971-2223 is sourced from website only
OSM tag internet_access=wlan is misleading — per the website, WiFi is only available at the Coffee & Treat Shack, not throughout the campground
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, actively operating campground with tenting sites, hot showers, and on-site food — a solid overnight option for touring cyclists heading north of Prince George.
enrichment_extras.notes: No explicit hiker/biker rate or cyclist-specific amenities mentioned. Firewood is sold on site but no camping fuel (propane, etc.) mentioned.

wow_evidence: renovated washhouse with flush toilets and free hot showers, and an on-site coffee-and-treats shack
